text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light steering ball joint and rod wear. A little play appears and steering becomes less precise.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate steering ball joint and rod wear. Play increases and the machine pulls slightly to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe steering ball joint and rod wear. Play is large and the machine pulls to one side and holds its line poorly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical steering ball joint and rod failure. The freed wheel no longer follows the steering wheel properly; driving is dangerous.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_knuckle_pivot_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light steering knuckle pivot wear. A little play appears in the steering.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_knuckle_pivot_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate steering knuckle pivot wear. Play in the steering becomes noticeable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_knuckle_pivot_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe steering knuckle pivot wear. Play in the steering is large.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_knuckle_pivot_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical steering knuckle pivot wear. The steering has very large play.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_orbitrol_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light steering orbitrol failure. The steering wheel turns with a little play before the wheels follow.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_orbitrol_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate steering orbitrol failure. The steering wheel turns farther before the wheels follow.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_orbitrol_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe steering orbitrol failure. The steering wheel turns a lot without the wheels following well.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_orbitrol_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical steering orbitrol failure. The steering wheel has very large play before the wheels follow.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light internal steering cylinder leak. The machine starts to drift to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light steering cylinder rod seal leak. Hydraulic oil level drops slightly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate internal steering cylinder leak. The machine drifts farther to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate steering cylinder rod seal leak. Hydraulic oil level drops noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe internal steering cylinder leak. The machine drifts clearly to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe steering cylinder rod seal leak. Hydraulic oil level drops quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical internal steering cylinder leak. The machine drifts strongly to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_cylinder_leak_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical steering cylinder rod seal leak. Hydraulic oil level drops very quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_pivot_pin_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light front loader pivot pin and bushing wear. Slight play appears at the arm joints.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_pivot_pin_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate front loader pivot pin and bushing wear. Play at the arm joints becomes noticeable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_pivot_pin_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe front loader pivot pin and bushing wear. The arm has large play.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_pivot_pin_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical front loader pivot pin and bushing wear. The arm play is very large.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cab_suspension_damper_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light cab damper leak. The cab is slightly less damped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cab_suspension_damper_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cab damper leak. The cab bounces over bumps.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cab_suspension_damper_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cab damper leak. The cab rocks with every jolt.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cab_suspension_damper_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cab damper leak. The damper is empty: the cab is hardly damped any more.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gear_disengage_message
text.text: Shifted to neutral

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Early glow plug degradation. Cold starts are becoming slower; warm starts remain unaffected.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Several glow plugs are weak or inoperative. Cold starts are difficult and the engine may idle unevenly until it warms up.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe glow plug failure. Cold starting is highly unreliable and rough running persists during warm-up.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete glow plug failure. The engine cannot be started when the temperature is too low.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_preheat_relay_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Preheat relay failure. The glow plugs no longer heat: the engine cannot be started when the temperature is too low.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_starter_relay_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Starter relay failure. The engine no longer cranks.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_low_beam_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the low-beam bulbs. These lights stay off until the bulbs are replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_high_beam_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the high-beam bulbs. These lights stay off until the bulbs are replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_work_lights_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the front work-light bulbs. These lights stay off until the bulbs are replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rear_work_lights_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the rear work-light bulbs. These lights stay off until the bulbs are replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_beacon_lights_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Beacon bulb failure. It stays off until the bulb is replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turn_lights_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the turn-signal bulbs. Neither the turn signals nor the hazard lights come on until the bulbs are replaced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO clutch wear. Drive occasionally drops out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO clutch wear. Drive drops out more often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO clutch wear. The implement often loses drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO clutch failure. The implement stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO clutch wear. Its plates are beginning to stick.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO clutch wear. Its plates stick more and more.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO clutch wear. Its plates stick: the PTO sometimes refuses to disengage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_clutch_wear_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO clutch failure. Its plates have welded: the PTO no longer disengages and the implement only stops with the machine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Early wear of the PTO output bearings. A light rumble appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the PTO output bearings. The rumble becomes clearly audible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the PTO output bearings. The rumble grows louder.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the PTO output bearings. The rumble is at its loudest.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_seal_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light PTO output seal leak. The transmission oil level drops slowly during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_seal_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO output seal leak. The transmission oil level drops during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_seal_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO output seal leak. Transmission oil runs out and its level drops quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_seal_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO output seal leak. There is not enough oil left for safe operation of the transmission.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO engagement solenoid wear. Drive occasionally cuts out during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO engagement solenoid wear. The PTO occasionally refuses to engage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO engagement solenoid wear. Cut-outs during work keep recurring.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO engagement solenoid wear. Refusals to engage keep recurring.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO engagement solenoid wear. Drive often cuts out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO engagement solenoid wear. The PTO often refuses to engage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO engagement solenoid failure. Its coil is open and the PTO no longer stays engaged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_solenoid_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO engagement solenoid failure. Its spool sticks and the PTO no longer engages.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO control switch wear. A loose contact occasionally cuts the drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO control switch wear. The PTO occasionally does not respond to the command.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO control switch wear. Loose contacts cut the drive more and more often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO control switch wear. The PTO ignores the command more and more often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO control switch wear. The contact no longer holds and the drive often cuts out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO control switch wear. The command often has no effect.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO control switch failure. Its contact stays open and the PTO cuts out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_switch_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO control switch failure. Its contact no longer closes and the PTO no longer engages.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_shaft_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: PTO output shaft failure. Its splines are stripped and no longer transmit drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_output_shaft_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: PTO output shaft failure. It has broken and the implement is no longer driven.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_speed_sensor_failure_stage1_description
text.text: PTO speed sensor failure. It no longer sends a signal and the safety system cuts out the PTO.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_brake_failure_stage1_description
text.text: PTO brake failure. It stays applied and locks the output shaft.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_pto_clutch_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Early front PTO clutch wear. The front output drive occasionally drops out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_pto_clutch_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate front PTO clutch wear. The front output drops out more often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_pto_clutch_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe front PTO clutch wear. The front implement often loses drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_pto_clutch_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical front PTO clutch failure. The front output no longer turns; the rear PTO is unaffected.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_blocked_message
text.text: PTO engagement refused

text.name: rms_breakdowns_quick_fix_stage
text.text: Temporary repair

text.name: rms_breakdowns_defected_parts_detected_description
text.text: The system is functioning normally, but the inspection has revealed a defective part. The part no longer offers any safety margin, so preventive replacement is recommended to avoid sudden failure.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_dead_battery_message
text.text: Battery too weak

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cold_traction_battery_message
text.text: Traction battery cold: range and power reduced

text.name: rms_breakdowns_temporarily_repaired_description
text.text: The system is functioning normally, but relies entirely on a temporary repair. To avoid a breakdown under load, a full replacement of the parts is recommended as soon as possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Worn turbocharger bearings. A faint whistling is audible and a slight loss of power appears at high engine speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Leaking turbocharger seals. Noticeable power loss and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Damaged turbine blades. Severe power loss and a risk of engine stalls under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical turbocharger failure. The engine has lost most of its power and risks severe internal damage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage1_description
text.text: Worn clutch plates. Occasional power loss due to clutch slip under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage2_description
text.text: Significant clutch wear. Noticeable clutch slip during acceleration and under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage3_description
text.text: Heavily worn clutch. Severe clutch slip makes it difficult to transfer power to the wheels.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage4_description
text.text: Clutch completely burned out. The vehicle is unable to move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Worn synchronizers. Occasional grinding or difficulty when shifting gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Damaged synchronizers. Shifting gears is frequently difficult and may fail.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Broken synchronizer teeth. High chance of failed shifts or of jumping out of gear under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Synchronizers completely failed. It is impossible to shift gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission oil leak. The oil level drops slowly during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission oil leak. The oil level drops noticeably and the transmission runs hotter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission oil leak. The oil level drops quickly and the transmission overheats under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission oil leak. There is not enough oil left for safe operation of the transmission.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light track tensioner malfunction. Track tension is a little less stable, which slightly increases drag and wear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate track tensioner malfunction. Tension becomes unstable, running efficiency drops and the risk of misalignment increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe track tensioner malfunction. Tension is heavily disturbed, drive transfer becomes inefficient and the risk of throwing a track increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical track tensioner failure. The track can no longer be held correctly and the vehicle can no longer be operated safely.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light thermostat failure. The engine warms slowly and stays too cool during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light thermostat failure. Temperature regulation is less precise and the temperature rises under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate thermostat failure. The engine warms slowly and stays too cool during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate thermostat failure. Temperature rises sooner and the engine runs hot under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe thermostat failure. The engine warms slowly and stays too cool during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe thermostat failure. The engine gets very hot; sustained work risks overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical thermostat failure. The engine warms slowly and stays too cool during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical thermostat failure. It stays closed and the engine overheats rapidly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage1_description
text.text: The engine has entered protection mode. Power is limited until the temperature drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage1_message
text.text: Overheat protection: power reduced

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage2_description
text.text: Overheat protection is tightening. The engine delivers only half its power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage2_message
text.text: Overheat protection: power halved

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage3_description
text.text: Overheat protection is at its maximum. Only a fraction of engine power remains.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage3_message
text.text: Overheat protection: power heavily reduced

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage4_description
text.text: The engine has been shut down to prevent damage. Let it cool before restarting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage4_message
text.text: Overheat protection: engine shut down

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is reduced, engine torque drops slightly, engine temperature rises and mechanical knocking may appear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is insufficient, engine torque is noticeably reduced, engine temperature is increased, and mechanical knocking is clearly audible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is critically low, engine torque is heavily reduced, engine overheating is likely, mechanical knocking is severe, and engine stalls may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical oil pump failure. Oil circulation is insufficient for safe engine operation and engine start or further operation is not possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_engine_jam_stage1_description
text.text: The engine has jammed and can no longer turn.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_engine_stalled_message
text.text: Engine stalled

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light ECU malfunction. Slightly reduced engine power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate ECU malfunction. Noticeable power loss and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe ECU malfunction. Major power loss, high fuel consumption and a risk of the engine stalling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete ECU failure. The engine cannot be controlled and will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the power cables and grounds. Increased contact resistance causes occasional light flicker, unstable supply and hard starting. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the power cables and grounds. Contact losses cause frequent light flicker, difficult starting and possible engine stalls. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the power cables and grounds. Supply to the circuits is unstable, lighting may fail completely, engine torque is reduced, stalls are frequent and starting is unreliable. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the power cables and grounds. Lighting is inoperative and the engine no longer cranks. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_electric_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the power cables and grounds. Increased contact resistance causes occasional light flicker and unstable supply. A current leak drains the auxiliary battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_electric_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the power cables and grounds. Contact losses cause frequent light flicker, unstable supply and possible cut-outs. A current leak drains the auxiliary battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_electric_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the power cables and grounds. Supply to the circuits is unstable, lighting may fail completely, power is reduced and cut-outs are likely. A current leak drains the auxiliary battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_power_cable_connection_failure_electric_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the power cables and grounds. Lighting is inoperative and the machine will not start. A current leak drains the auxiliary battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. A slight seep barely lowers the coolant level.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. A slightly crushed hose reduces coolant flow a little.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. The leak becomes visible and the level drops further.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. Restricted flow makes the temperature rise sooner under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. A large coolant loss puts the engine at risk of overheating under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. Flow is low and the engine overheats during sustained work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. The level falls quickly and the cooling circuit may empty.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_hose_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the coolant hoses and fittings. Flow is severely restricted and the engine overheats quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light expansion tank failure. A crack lets a little coolant seep out.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light expansion tank failure. The connection seeps slightly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate expansion tank failure. The crack causes a clear leak and the level drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate expansion tank failure. The connection visibly leaks and the level drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe expansion tank failure. The leak makes the coolant level fall quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe expansion tank failure. Coolant is lost quickly at the connection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical expansion tank failure. Coolant escapes quickly and the circuit empties.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_expansion_tank_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical expansion tank failure. The connection leak quickly empties the circuit.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_accessory_belt_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the accessory belt and tensioner. It squeals and slips slightly; charging and coolant flow dip a little.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_accessory_belt_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the accessory belt and tensioner. It slips under load; charging drops and coolant flow slows.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_accessory_belt_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the accessory belt and tensioner. It slips badly; charging and coolant flow are greatly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_accessory_belt_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the accessory belt and tensioner. It breaks; charging and coolant circulation stop at once.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_blade_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light fan blade failure. Airflow drops slightly; cooling slows mainly at low speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_blade_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fan blade failure. Airflow falls noticeably and the temperature rises further.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_blade_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fan blade failure. Airflow is noticeably reduced and the engine heats up under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_blade_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fan blade failure. Airflow drops by half and the engine overheats quickly under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_cooling_fan_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light electric cooling fan failure. It moves slightly less air when cooling is needed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_cooling_fan_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate electric cooling fan failure. Air movement drops noticeably and the temperature rises sooner.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_cooling_fan_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe electric cooling fan failure. Air movement is noticeably reduced and the temperature rises under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_cooling_fan_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical electric cooling fan failure. Air movement drops by half and the temperature rises quickly under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Early signs of a CVT transmission malfunction have been detected. An inspection and a repair are required.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The CVT transmission malfunction is getting worse. Continued operation may lead to emergency mode.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Critical CVT transmission damage. The transmission is in emergency mode and the maximum vehicle speed is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete CVT transmission failure. The vehicle cannot be used until it is repaired.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage1_description
text.text: Light battery sulfation. Effective capacity is reduced, lowering the electrical reserve under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate battery sulfation. Effective battery capacity is significantly reduced and engine starting is difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage3_description
text.text: Severe battery sulfation. Usable battery capacity is critically low and cranking performance is unstable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage4_description
text.text: Critical battery sulfation. Effective capacity is almost nil and cranking power is insufficient for a reliable start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_electric_stage1_description
text.text: Light auxiliary battery sulfation. Effective capacity is reduced, lowering the electrical reserve under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_electric_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate auxiliary battery sulfation. Effective capacity is significantly reduced and the electrical reserve runs out sooner.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_electric_stage3_description
text.text: Severe auxiliary battery sulfation. Usable capacity is critically low and the electrical reserve runs out very quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_electric_stage4_description
text.text: Critical auxiliary battery sulfation. Effective capacity is almost nil and no longer enough for a reliable start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_disc_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light brake disc and lining wear. Braking effectiveness drops slightly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_disc_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate brake disc and lining wear. Braking distance increases noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_disc_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe brake disc and lining wear. Braking becomes very weak and unreliable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_disc_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical brake disc and lining failure. The machine brakes very poorly and driving becomes dangerous.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light brake control failure. The machine pulls slightly to one side when braking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light brake control failure. The pedal feels slightly soft and braking is a little less effective.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate brake control failure. Braking pulls noticeably to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate brake control failure. The pedal feels soft, pressure drops and braking is noticeably less effective.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe brake control failure. The machine pulls strongly to one side when braking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe brake control failure. The pedal sinks unusually far, pressure drops and the machine brakes poorly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical brake control failure. Braking pulls sharply to one side.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_control_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical brake control failure. The pedal offers almost no resistance and the machine barely brakes.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_trailer_brake_valve_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light trailer brake valve failure. The trailer loses a small share of its braking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_trailer_brake_valve_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate trailer brake valve failure. The trailer brakes noticeably less.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_trailer_brake_valve_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe trailer brake valve failure. The trailer receives only a small share of the braking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_trailer_brake_valve_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical trailer brake valve failure. The trailer no longer brakes.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_park_brake_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light parking brake failure. Once released, it still rubs a little and slightly slows the machine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_park_brake_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate parking brake failure. Once released, it drags noticeably and holds the machine back.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_park_brake_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe parking brake failure. Once released, it stays half engaged and strongly holds the machine back.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_park_brake_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete parking brake failure. It no longer releases and holds the machine as if it were engaged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_wheel_hub_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light wheel hub bearing and seal wear. Resistance rises slightly and an unusual noise may appear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_wheel_hub_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wheel hub bearing and seal wear. Friction and noise rise, reducing mechanical efficiency.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_wheel_hub_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wheel hub bearing and seal wear. Friction is high, noise is loud and seizure under load becomes likely.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_wheel_hub_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical wheel hub bearing and seal failure. Complete seizure is imminent and the machine can no longer operate.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_roller_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light track roller and idler bearing wear. Resistance rises slightly and an unusual noise may appear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_roller_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate track roller and idler bearing wear. Friction and noise rise, and rolling becomes harder.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_roller_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe track roller and idler bearing wear. Friction and noise are high, with a risk of seizure under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_roller_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical track roller and idler bearing failure. The track may stop if one seizes.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light alternator regulator failure. Charging output is reduced, which lowers battery charging efficiency.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate alternator regulator failure. Charging is reduced and unstable, causing poor battery charging and increased voltage losses.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe alternator regulator failure. Charging is heavily reduced, the supply is unstable and the electrical system operates with major losses.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Complete alternator regulator failure. Battery charging is absent and the electrical system is operating only from the remaining battery reserve.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the alternator diodes. Charging output is reduced, which lowers battery charging efficiency. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the alternator diodes. Charging is reduced and unstable, causing poor battery charging and increased voltage losses. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the alternator diodes. Charging is heavily reduced, the supply is unstable and the electrical system operates with major losses. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Complete failure of the alternator diodes. Battery charging is absent and the electrical system is operating only from the remaining battery reserve. A current leak drains the battery while the machine is parked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_starter_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light starter failure. The starter turns the engine over more slowly, and starting takes a little longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_starter_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate starter failure. The starter turns the engine over slowly: starting is difficult, and impossible in severe cold.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_starter_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe starter failure. The starter barely turns the engine over: it only starts with a warm engine or in mild weather.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_starter_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete starter failure. The starter no longer turns the engine over: a running engine keeps running, but once stopped it cannot be restarted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light wear of the electric motor bearings. A faint noise appears and energy consumption rises a little.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the electric motor bearings. The noise is clearly audible, energy consumption rises and power drops slightly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the electric motor bearings. The noise is loud, the motor runs hot and power drops noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the electric motor bearings. The motor is seized and the machine can no longer move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_winding_fault_stage1_description
text.text: Light degradation of the electric motor windings. Power drops slightly and the motor runs hotter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_winding_fault_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate degradation of the electric motor windings. Power drops noticeably, the motor runs hot and energy consumption rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_winding_fault_stage3_description
text.text: Severe degradation of the electric motor windings. The power loss is major, the motor runs very hot and cut-outs may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_electric_motor_winding_fault_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the electric motor windings. The motor is short-circuited and can no longer run.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_motor_position_sensor_fault_stage1_description
text.text: Light malfunction of the motor position sensor. Brief jerks appear under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_motor_position_sensor_fault_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate malfunction of the motor position sensor. The jerks are frequent and power drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_motor_position_sensor_fault_stage3_description
text.text: Severe malfunction of the motor position sensor. The jerks are violent, power falls sharply and cut-outs occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_motor_position_sensor_fault_stage4_description
text.text: Complete failure of the motor position sensor. The motor can no longer be controlled and the machine will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inverter_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light inverter malfunction. Motor power is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inverter_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate inverter malfunction. The power loss is noticeable and energy consumption rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inverter_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe inverter malfunction. The power loss is major and cut-outs may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inverter_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete inverter failure. The motor is no longer powered and the machine will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_dcdc_converter_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light voltage converter failure. The auxiliary battery charges less well.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_dcdc_converter_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate voltage converter failure. Charging of the auxiliary battery is reduced and unstable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_dcdc_converter_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe voltage converter failure. The auxiliary battery is barely charged and drains while driving.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_dcdc_converter_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete voltage converter failure. The auxiliary battery is no longer charged and the machine runs on its remaining reserve only.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_onboard_charger_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light on-board charger failure. Charging at the station is a little slower.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_onboard_charger_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate on-board charger failure. Charging at the station is noticeably slower.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_onboard_charger_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe on-board charger failure. Charging at the station is very slow.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_onboard_charger_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete on-board charger failure. The traction battery can no longer be charged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_insulation_loss_stage1_description
text.text: Light insulation loss in the high-voltage wiring. A warning is shown, with no other effect.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_insulation_loss_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate insulation loss in the high-voltage wiring. Power is reduced as a safety measure.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_insulation_loss_stage3_description
text.text: Severe insulation loss in the high-voltage wiring. Power is heavily reduced and cut-outs occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_insulation_loss_stage4_description
text.text: Critical insulation loss in the high-voltage wiring. The machine refuses to start as a safety measure.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_traction_battery_cell_fault_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of traction battery cells. Range drops slightly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_traction_battery_cell_fault_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of traction battery cells. Range drops noticeably and power is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_traction_battery_cell_fault_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of traction battery cells. Range and power fall sharply, and cut-outs may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_traction_battery_cell_fault_stage4_description
text.text: Critical traction battery failure. The machine can no longer be switched on.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_contactor_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light wear of the high-voltage contactor. Rare power cut-outs occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_contactor_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the high-voltage contactor. Power cut-outs become regular.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_contactor_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the high-voltage contactor. Power cut-outs are frequent.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hv_contactor_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the high-voltage contactor. The traction battery no longer powers the machine, which will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_pump_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light coolant pump failure. The coolant circulates less well and the temperature rises a little more.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_pump_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate coolant pump failure. Cooling is noticeably reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_pump_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe coolant pump failure. Cooling is heavily reduced and overheating is likely under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_pump_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete coolant pump failure. The coolant barely circulates and the machine overheats quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light water pump failure. The fault is still barely noticeable and needs inspection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate water pump failure. Circulation is reduced and cooling becomes less effective.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe water pump failure. Insufficient circulation puts the engine at risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical water pump failure. Circulation is severely impaired and cooling is greatly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light water pump failure. Light traces of coolant appear around the water pump seal.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate water pump failure. Coolant leaks through the water pump seal; the level falls and circulation becomes less effective.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe water pump failure. The water pump seal leak leaves heavy traces around the pump; the level falls and reduced circulation raises the risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical water pump failure. The water pump seal leaks heavily; the circuit loses coolant and circulation can no longer cool the engine properly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch3_stage1_description
text.text: Light water pump failure. The fault is still barely noticeable and needs inspection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch3_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate water pump failure. The pump bearing develops play and circulation is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch3_stage3_description
text.text: Severe water pump failure. Insufficient circulation puts the engine at risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermal_water_pump_branch3_stage4_description
text.text: Critical water pump failure. Circulation is severely impaired and cooling is greatly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light radiator core failure. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate radiator core failure. It removes less heat from the coolant.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe radiator core failure. It removes heat poorly and the risk of overheating increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical radiator core failure. It removes very little heat and cooling is severely impaired.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light radiator core failure. Coolant seepage appears on the core tubes.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate radiator core failure. Damaged tubes leak coolant onto the radiator and the circuit level falls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe radiator core failure. Coolant escapes through the damaged core tubes, leaving wet traces on the radiator; the circuit reserve shrinks quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_radiator_core_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical radiator core failure. The damaged core loses substantial coolant. The level drops and the radiator can no longer remove enough engine heat.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_reducer_gear_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light wear of the gears and bearings of the reduction gear. A faint noise appears while driving.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_reducer_gear_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the gears and bearings of the reduction gear. The noise is clearly audible and energy consumption rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_reducer_gear_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the gears and bearings of the reduction gear. The noise is loud, the reduction gear runs hot and power at the wheels drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_reducer_gear_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical reduction gear failure. It is seized and the machine can no longer move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the pistons. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the pistons. More oil reaches the combustion chamber and blue smoke appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the pistons. Oil consumption rises and blue smoke increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the pistons. A piston has seized and the engine is locked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the pistons. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the pistons. More oil reaches the combustion chamber and blue smoke appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the pistons. Oil consumption rises and blue smoke increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pistons_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the pistons. A piston has fractured and the engine has stopped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the piston rings. Deposits restrict the rings in their grooves.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the piston rings. Sealing deteriorates and the engine loses power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the piston rings. Loss of compression makes starting difficult and reduces power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the piston rings. Compression is very low, starting is difficult and power is greatly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the piston rings. Deposits restrict the rings in their grooves.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the piston rings. More oil reaches the combustion chamber and blue smoke appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the piston rings. Oil consumption rises and blue smoke increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the piston rings. Oil entry is substantial and blue smoke persists.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch3_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the piston rings. Deposits restrict the rings in their grooves.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch3_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the piston rings. Sealing deteriorates and the engine loses power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch3_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the piston rings. Loss of compression makes starting difficult and reduces power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_piston_rings_branch3_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the piston rings. A piston ring has broken: compression drops and oil enters the combustion chamber.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the cylinder liners. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the cylinder liners. The surface is scored and sealing is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the cylinder liners. The surface is scored and sealing is reduced. Oil consumption rises and blue smoke increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the cylinder liners. A piston has seized in its cylinder liner and the engine is locked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the cylinder liners. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the cylinder liners. Coolant leaks through a cracked liner into a cylinder, lowering the level.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the cylinder liners. A cracked liner lets coolant enter a cylinder; white smoke appears at the exhaust.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_liners_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the cylinder liners. Coolant leaks heavily through a cracked liner into a cylinder, with persistent white smoke and insufficient cooling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the intake valves. The valve face is damaged and power is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the intake valves. The valve closes poorly, causing misfires and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the intake valves. The valve face is burnt, causing misfires, stalling and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the intake valves. The burnt valve face causes misfires, stalling and major power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the intake valves. The valve face is damaged and power is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the intake valves. The valve closes poorly, causing misfires and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the intake valves. The valve face is burnt, causing misfires, stalling and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_inlet_valves_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the intake valves. An intake valve has broken and the engine has stopped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the exhaust valves. The valve face is damaged and power is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the exhaust valves. The valve closes poorly, causing misfires and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the exhaust valves. The valve face is burnt, causing misfires, stalling and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the exhaust valves. The burnt valve face causes misfires, stalling and major power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the exhaust valves. The valve face is damaged and power is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the exhaust valves. The valve closes poorly, causing misfires and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the exhaust valves. The valve face is burnt, causing misfires, stalling and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_exhaust_valves_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the exhaust valves. An exhaust valve has broken and the engine has stopped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Inspection reveals faulty guidance and the valves become noisy.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Clearance increases and the valves become noisy.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Excessive clearance causes noise, misfires and oil passage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Guide clearance is excessive, with noise, misfires and blue smoke.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the valve guides and stem seals. The hardened seal lets oil through.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the valve guides and stem seals. More oil reaches the combustion chamber and blue smoke appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Oil consumption rises and blue smoke increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_guides_seals_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the valve guides and stem seals. Oil entry is substantial and blue smoke persists.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head failure. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head failure. A crack in the cylinder head lets coolant enter a combustion chamber; the engine loses power and is hard to start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head failure. Coolant passes through the cracked cylinder head into a combustion chamber, causing white smoke and power loss.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head failure. A crack lets substantial coolant into a combustion chamber. The engine lacks power, is hard to start and emits white smoke.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head failure. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head failure. Coolant seeps from the cracked cylinder head and the circuit level falls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head failure. The coolant leak leaves visible traces on the cracked cylinder head and the level falls quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head failure. Coolant escapes heavily from the cracked cylinder head; the circuit drains and the engine is at risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch3_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head failure. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch3_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head failure. Coolant leaks through a crack in the cylinder head into the oil, lowering the circuit level.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch3_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head failure. The cylinder head crack lets more coolant into the oil; the circuit level keeps falling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_branch3_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head failure. The cylinder head crack diverts substantial coolant into the oil; the circuit loses its reserve and the engine is at risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head gasket failure. The fault is still barely noticeable and needs inspection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head gasket failure. It lets coolant enter a combustion chamber; cranking takes longer and power falls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head gasket failure. Coolant passes through it into a combustion chamber and produces white smoke at the exhaust.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head gasket failure. It lets substantial coolant into a combustion chamber; white smoke increases and starting becomes very difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head gasket failure. The fault is still barely noticeable and needs inspection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head gasket failure. Coolant seeps at it and lowers the circuit level.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head gasket failure. A coolant leak at it leaves traces on the engine and makes the level fall quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head gasket failure. It lets substantial coolant escape outside; the level drops and engine cooling deteriorates badly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch3_stage1_description
text.text: Light cylinder head gasket failure. The fault is still barely noticeable and needs inspection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch3_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate cylinder head gasket failure. Coolant passes through it into the oil; the circuit level falls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch3_stage3_description
text.text: Severe cylinder head gasket failure. It leaks increasing amounts of coolant into the oil; the circuit gradually loses its coolant.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cylinder_head_gasket_branch3_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cylinder head gasket failure. A major leak through it sends coolant into the oil and deprives the circuit of the fluid needed for cooling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the crankshaft bearings. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the crankshaft bearings. Bearing clearance increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the crankshaft bearings. The oil film is impaired, causing knocking and heat.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the crankshaft bearings. A crankshaft bearing has seized, locking the engine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the crankshaft bearings. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the crankshaft bearings. Bearing clearance increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the crankshaft bearings. The oil film is impaired, causing knocking and heat.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_main_bearings_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the crankshaft bearings. A crankshaft bearing lining has melted and the engine has stopped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the connecting rod bearings. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the connecting rod bearings. Bearing clearance increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the connecting rod bearings. The oil film is impaired, causing knocking and heat.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the connecting rod bearings. A connecting rod bearing has seized, locking the engine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the connecting rod bearings. Inspection reveals a damaged surface.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the connecting rod bearings. Bearing clearance increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the connecting rod bearings. The oil film is impaired, causing knocking and heat.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_conrod_bearings_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the connecting rod bearings. A connecting rod bearing lining has melted and the engine has stopped.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_voltage_sag_message
text.text: Insufficient circuit voltage

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Early fuel feed pump wear. Slightly reduced engine power and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Fuel pressure dropping. Noticeable power loss, higher fuel consumption, and occasional engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Critical fuel pressure. Severe power loss, very high fuel consumption, and frequent engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete fuel feed pump failure. Fuel is not supplied to the engine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: One or more injectors have slightly clogged nozzles. The engine may run a bit rough, with a minor loss of power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Poor fuel atomization. The engine hesitates under load, with noticeable power loss and jerking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: A fuel injector is stuck. The engine runs very poorly, with significant power loss and unreliable starting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: An injector has completely failed. The engine will not run correctly and may not start at all.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_high_pressure_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light high-pressure pump failure. Injection pressure builds up more slowly, so starting takes longer and the engine responds less sharply.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_high_pressure_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate high-pressure pump failure. Injection pressure falls short under load, with noticeable power loss and hesitation.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_high_pressure_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe high-pressure pump failure. Injection pressure is critically low, with major power loss, engine stalls and difficult starting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_high_pressure_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete high-pressure pump failure. The pump no longer builds injection pressure: the engine turns over but does not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: Light fuel filter clogging. Fuel flow drops slightly under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fuel filter clogging. Flow becomes insufficient under load, power drops and the engine sometimes hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fuel filter clogging. Fuel supply is heavily restricted, power drops noticeably and stalls are possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: Fuel filter fully obstructed. The engine no longer receives enough fuel to run reliably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light air leak in the fuel line. Fuel supply becomes slightly irregular.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate air leak in the fuel line. The supply becomes unstable, power drops and hesitation appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe air leak in the fuel line. The engine runs very unevenly and the risk of stalling is high.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fuel line failure with a major air leak. The engine can no longer be supplied correctly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light pinching of the fuel line. Flow drops: the engine starts, then stalls now and then.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate pinching of the fuel line. The engine starts, then stalls regularly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe pinching of the fuel line. The engine stalls often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Crushed fuel line. Fuel no longer gets through: the engine stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_mechanical_injection_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light mechanical injection pump failure. Delivery weakens: starting takes longer and the engine lacks a little vigour.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_mechanical_injection_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate mechanical injection pump failure. Delivery falls short under load: the engine loses power and hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_mechanical_injection_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe mechanical injection pump failure. The engine runs short of fuel, loses a lot of power, starts poorly and stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_mechanical_injection_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical mechanical injection pump failure. Its drive has broken: the engine stops and will not restart.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_metering_valve_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light fuel metering valve failure. The rail builds pressure more slowly and starting takes longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_metering_valve_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fuel metering valve failure. Rail pressure no longer keeps up under load: the engine loses power and hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_metering_valve_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fuel metering valve failure. Rail pressure strays far from its target: the engine loses a lot of power and stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_metering_valve_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fuel metering valve failure. The rail is no longer pressurised: the starter turns the engine but it will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_sensor_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light rail pressure sensor failure. Its reading becomes unstable and starting takes a little longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_sensor_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate rail pressure sensor failure. The ECU controls the pressure poorly: the engine loses power and hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_sensor_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe rail pressure sensor failure. The engine drops into limp mode, loses a lot of power and may stall.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_sensor_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical rail pressure sensor failure. Without a reading, the ECU keeps the engine in limp mode.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_limiter_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light rail pressure limiting valve failure. It opens too early: the rail builds pressure more slowly and starting takes longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_limiter_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate rail pressure limiting valve failure. Rail pressure no longer holds under load: the engine loses power and hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_limiter_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe rail pressure limiting valve failure. Rail pressure collapses: the engine loses a lot of power and stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rail_pressure_limiter_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical rail pressure limiting valve failure. It stays open: the rail is no longer pressurised and the starter turns the engine but it will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_pressure_regulator_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light gas pressure regulator failure. Supply pressure fluctuates and starting takes longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_pressure_regulator_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate gas pressure regulator failure. Pressure drops under load: the engine loses power and hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_pressure_regulator_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe gas pressure regulator failure. The supply becomes irregular: the engine loses a lot of power, starts poorly and stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_pressure_regulator_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical gas pressure regulator failure. It no longer lets enough gas through: the engine stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_shutoff_solenoid_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light gas shutoff solenoid failure. It opens late: starting takes longer and the engine falters at times.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_shutoff_solenoid_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate gas shutoff solenoid failure. It sometimes cuts the gas: the engine falters and stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_shutoff_solenoid_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe gas shutoff solenoid failure. The cuts multiply and the engine often stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_shutoff_solenoid_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical gas shutoff solenoid failure. It stays closed: the engine stops and will not restart.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: Light gas filter clogging. Gas flow drops slightly under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate gas filter clogging. The supply no longer keeps up under load: power drops and the engine may stall.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: Severe gas filter clogging. Flow is heavily restricted: power drops noticeably and the engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: Gas filter fully obstructed. The engine no longer receives enough gas and stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_line_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light gas line leak. Starting takes a little longer.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_line_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate gas line leak. The supply becomes irregular: the engine falters and may stall.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_line_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe gas line leak. Pressure drops: the engine falters, starts poorly and often stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_line_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical gas line leak. Pressure no longer holds: the engine stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_injector_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the gas injectors. Dosing becomes irregular: the engine runs less smoothly and uses a little more gas.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_injector_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the gas injectors. The engine falters, loses power, uses more gas and may stall.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_injector_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the gas injectors. One injector doses very poorly: heavy power loss, high consumption and hard starting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gas_injector_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the gas injectors. Dosing no longer lets the engine run: it stops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_pump_failure_stage1_description
text.text: AdBlue pump failure. It no longer feeds the dosing: the engine lamp comes on, then the ECU reduces power until the repair.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_doser_failure_stage1_description
text.text: AdBlue dosing injector failure. Clogged with crystals, it no longer sprays: the engine lamp comes on and power drops later until the repair.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: The AdBlue filter is due and beginning to clog. The most complete service replaces it.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: The AdBlue filter is clogged: AdBlue flow drops and the engine lamp comes on. The most complete service replaces it.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: The AdBlue filter is heavily clogged: dosing fails and the ECU reduces power until the repair.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_adblue_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: The AdBlue filter is fully obstructed: no dosing at all, the ECU reduces power until the repair.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_nox_sensor_failure_stage1_description
