text.text: NOx sensor failure. The ECU no longer monitors emissions: the engine lamp comes on, and after several dozen hours power is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light particulate filter failure. A crack lets a little soot through to the exhaust.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate particulate filter failure. The crack widens: black smoke becomes visible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe particulate filter failure. The substrate breaks up: the exhaust gives off heavy black smoke.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical particulate filter failure. The substrate has broken: soot passes through unfiltered.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light particulate filter failure. Part of the substrate has melted and is plugging.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate particulate filter failure. The melted area spreads: back pressure rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe particulate filter failure. Melted and plugged, it no longer regenerates: engine speed is limited.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical particulate filter failure. Fully blocked, it no longer lets the gases through: only a replacement gives the engine its power back.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_soot_overload_stage1_description
text.text: Particulate filter overload. Regenerations have not completed: engine speed is limited until one succeeds.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_particulate_filter_soot_overload_stage2_description
text.text: Critical particulate filter overload. Too loaded to regenerate on its own, it needs a service regeneration at the workshop; engine speed stays limited.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light fan clutch failure. The fan responds less effectively and cooling is slightly degraded.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fan clutch failure. Fan engagement is erratic and cooling efficiency drops noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fan clutch failure. The fan no longer provides enough airflow and the engine overheats more easily.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fan clutch failure. The fan can no longer provide the necessary cooling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Ratio control responds more slowly and less precisely.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The ratio varies irregularly and control responds poorly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Ratio control is severely disrupted and transmitted drive effort drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Ratio control has failed and the transmission is almost unusable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. A raised implement drifts slowly under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Downward drift is noticeable and increases with the carried load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Heavy implements can no longer reliably hold their position.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Any raised load drops rapidly on its own.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Minor internal leak in the hydraulic pump. Implements operate slightly more slowly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Worn seals on the hydraulic pump. Noticeably slower hydraulic operation.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Damaged hydraulic pump. Implements are extremely slow and weak.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Hydraulic pump failure. Hydraulic system is inoperable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage1_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose shows light moisture. A little oil escapes and hydraulic response is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage2_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose is visibly seeping. Oil loss continues and hydraulic functions respond more slowly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage3_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose is actively leaking. Oil loss is obvious and hydraulic functions are noticeably weakened.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage4_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose has a severe external leak. Oil is escaping quickly and hydraulic performance is strongly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is slightly clogged and beginning to restrict flow. Hydraulic functions are slightly slower. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is moderately clogged. All hydraulic functions are noticeably slower. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is heavily clogged. Hydraulic response is very slow. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is fully obstructed. Hydraulic functions barely respond. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler has lost some efficiency. Oil temperature rises slightly during prolonged hydraulic work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler is underperforming. Oil temperature rises noticeably during sustained hydraulic work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler is badly degraded. Heavy hydraulic work quickly overheats the oil.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler has failed. Prolonged hydraulic work causes severe oil overheating and accelerates pump wear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage1_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is beginning to stick. One hydraulic function occasionally hesitates and weakens under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage2_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is sticking intermittently. One hydraulic function is slower and loses more force as load increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage3_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is sticking badly. One hydraulic function moves erratically and struggles under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage4_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is critically damaged. One hydraulic function repeatedly stops and can barely move a heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_manual_transmission_clutch_wear_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light clutch failure. It does not fully release. Some gear selections are difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_manual_transmission_clutch_wear_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate clutch failure. The mechanism releases the disc poorly. Gear selections are refused more often.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_manual_transmission_clutch_wear_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe clutch failure. The disc remains driven when the clutch is released. Gear selection is severely disrupted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_manual_transmission_clutch_wear_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical clutch failure. The mechanism no longer releases the disc. No gear can be engaged normally.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gearbox_bearing_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the gearbox bearings. The rolling surfaces are damaged. A faint rumble comes from the gearbox.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gearbox_bearing_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the gearbox bearings. The bearing races are damaged. The gearbox rumble becomes clearly audible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gearbox_bearing_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the gearbox bearings. The bearings turn with difficulty. The gearbox rumbles loudly and may seize.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_gearbox_bearing_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the gearbox bearings. The bearings have seized. The gearbox is blocked and the machine cannot move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack transmits drive poorly. A gear slips slightly under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack applies late. A gear engages with a slight jolt.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack no longer clamps firmly enough. The gear slips noticeably under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack fills poorly. The gear engages harshly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack can barely hold the load. Very little drive reaches the wheels.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the powershift gear clutches. A clutch pack engages very poorly. Gear changes cause strong jolts.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the powershift gear clutches. The clutch pack no longer transmits drive. The machine cannot move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_clutch_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the powershift gear clutches. The clutch pack no longer engages correctly. The gear no longer drives the machine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A forward or reverse clutch slips slightly as drive is taken up.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A reverser clutch takes up late. Drive resumes with a slight jolt.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A reverser clutch slips noticeably. Drive is poorly transmitted in the requested direction.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A reverser clutch applies abruptly. Changing direction jolts the machine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A reverser clutch can barely hold the load. Drive is severely reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the powershift reverser clutches. A reverser clutch applies very unevenly. Drive take-up is very harsh.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the powershift reverser clutches. The reverser clutch no longer transmits drive. The machine cannot move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_reverser_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the powershift reverser clutches. The reverser clutch no longer engages correctly. Drive is lost.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission control failure. Electrohydraulic control acts unevenly. A gear change hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission control failure. Control occasionally refuses a gear selection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission control failure. Control disrupts clutch filling. Gear changes cause noticeable jolts.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission control failure. Control refuses several selections. Engaging gears becomes difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission control failure. Control applies the clutches poorly. Gear changes cause strong jolts.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission control failure. Control no longer executes many selections. Gears are rarely available.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission control failure. Control can no longer engage the clutches correctly. Gear changes are severely disrupted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_control_failure_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission control failure. Control no longer allows a gear to be selected. The gearbox does not respond to the request.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_sensor_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Transmission speed sensor failure. Its signal turns erratic: the control sometimes refuses a gear change.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_sensor_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Transmission pressure sensor failure. The control misjudges clutch filling: gear changes come late and jolt.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_sensor_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Critical transmission speed sensor failure. Without its reading, the control often refuses gear changes.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_sensor_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Critical transmission pressure sensor failure. Without its reading, every gear change comes very late and takes up at once.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_sensor_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Transmission speed sensor failure. The control switches to its limp mode: travel speed is limited.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_sensor_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Transmission pressure sensor failure. The control switches to its limp mode: travel speed is limited.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_sensor_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Critical transmission speed sensor failure. The limp mode leaves only a low travel speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_sensor_failure_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Critical transmission pressure sensor failure. The limp mode leaves only a low travel speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission pump failure. Control oil supply drops. Engagement hesitates and drive is briefly interrupted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission pump failure. Control pressure is insufficient. Gears engage harshly and drive is interrupted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission pump failure. The pump can barely supply control oil. Engagement is very harsh and drive is often interrupted.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission pump failure. The pump cannot supply the required pressure. The transmission no longer drives the machine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydrostatic_unit_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light hydrostatic unit failure. Internal leakage reduces drive. The variator loses some speed and the oil runs hotter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydrostatic_unit_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate hydrostatic unit failure. Internal leakage increases. Maximum speed drops, the oil runs hot and fuel consumption rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydrostatic_unit_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe hydrostatic unit failure. The rotating group can barely transmit drive. Speed drops sharply and the oil runs very hot under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydrostatic_unit_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical hydrostatic unit failure. The rotating group no longer transmits drive. The machine cannot move while the engine keeps running.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission oil cooler failure. It removes less heat. Transmission oil runs hotter under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission oil cooler failure. Heat exchange is noticeably reduced. Transmission oil stays hotter during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission oil cooler failure. It removes very little heat. Transmission oil may overheat under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission oil cooler failure. Transmission oil cooling has failed. Sustained work puts the transmission at risk of overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: The transmission filter is due and beginning to clog. The display asks for its replacement. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: The transmission filter is clogged: its bypass valve opens and the gearbox oil passes unfiltered. The transmission wears faster. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: The transmission filter is heavily clogged. The gearbox oil circulates unfiltered and wears the transmission. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: The transmission filter is fully obstructed. All the gearbox oil passes unfiltered and wears the transmission. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rear_bevel_gear_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light rear axle bevel gear set failure. The bevel gear teeth are damaged. A faint whine appears under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rear_bevel_gear_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate rear axle bevel gear set failure. Tooth contact is disrupted. The rear axle whines noticeably under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rear_bevel_gear_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe rear axle bevel gear set failure. The teeth are badly damaged. The rear axle whines loudly and may lose drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_rear_bevel_gear_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical rear axle bevel gear set failure. The bevel gear set no longer transmits drive. The rear axle is no longer driven and the machine cannot move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_final_drive_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the final drives. The teeth of a final drive are damaged. A faint whine appears near a driven wheel.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_final_drive_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the final drives. The gears of a final drive turn poorly. The whine at the wheel is clearly audible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_final_drive_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the final drives. The gears of a final drive are badly damaged. Noise is loud and drive may fail.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_final_drive_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the final drives. A final drive no longer transmits drive to its wheel. The machine cannot move normally.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_four_wd_control_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: 4WD engagement failure. Four-wheel drive no longer engages. The front axle stays disengaged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_four_wd_control_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: 4WD engagement failure. The front axle stays engaged. Four-wheel drive cannot be disengaged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Hydraulic pump failure. It is broken. Pressure is lost and the hydraulic functions no longer respond.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_malfunction_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Hydraulic control valve failure. The spool is stuck. The affected hydraulic function no longer moves.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_lift_valve_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Lift valve failure. It no longer holds the load correctly. The raised implement sinks.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_lift_valve_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Lift valve failure. It is stuck. The lift no longer responds.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_lift_position_sensor_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Lift position sensor failure. The position signal has failed. The lift no longer holds the requested height and a fault code is stored.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_control_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light loader control failure. The arm and bucket respond more slowly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_control_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate loader control failure. The arm and bucket move at half speed only.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_control_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe loader control failure. The arm and bucket barely move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_loader_control_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical loader control failure. The arm and bucket no longer respond.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light hydraulic cylinder failure. The rod seal lets some oil escape. Slight wetness appears around the rod.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate hydraulic cylinder failure. The rod seal no longer seals correctly. The cylinder seeps and the oil level drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe hydraulic cylinder failure. The rod seal leaks actively. The cylinder loses a significant amount of oil.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical hydraulic cylinder failure. The rod seal lets a large amount of oil escape. The circuit level drops rapidly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_quick_coupler_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the hydraulic quick couplers. A coupler seal has failed. Slight wetness appears at the connection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_quick_coupler_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Failure of the hydraulic quick couplers. A coupler's oil passage is blocked. The connected hydraulic function no longer moves.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_quick_coupler_failure_branch1_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the hydraulic quick couplers. A coupler seeps. The circuit loses oil at the connection.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_quick_coupler_failure_branch1_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the hydraulic quick couplers. A coupler leaks actively. Oil loss at the connection becomes significant.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_quick_coupler_failure_branch1_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the hydraulic quick couplers. A coupler leaks heavily. The circuit oil level drops rapidly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Light hydraulic oil cooler failure. The cooler core is no longer fully sealed. Slight wetness appears on the core.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_branch2_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate hydraulic oil cooler failure. The cooler core seeps. The hydraulic oil level drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_branch2_stage3_description
text.text: Severe hydraulic oil cooler failure. The cooler core leaks actively. The circuit loses a significant amount of oil.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_branch2_stage4_description
text.text: Critical hydraulic oil cooler failure. The cooler core leaks heavily. The hydraulic oil level drops rapidly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_part_diff_lock_control
text.text: Differential Lock Control

text.name: rms_breakdowns_differential_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light failure of the differential gears. The tooth surfaces are damaged. A faint noise appears when turning.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_differential_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate failure of the differential gears. Tooth contact is disrupted. Differential noise is clearly audible when turning.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_differential_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe failure of the differential gears. The teeth are badly damaged. Noise is loud when turning and drive may fail.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_differential_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the differential gears. The gears no longer transmit drive. The machine cannot move while the engine keeps running.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_axle_shaft_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light wear of the front axle drive shaft universal joints. Slight play appears in the front axle drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_axle_shaft_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the front axle drive shaft universal joints. Play in the joints becomes clear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_axle_shaft_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the front axle drive shaft universal joints. A joint is close to breaking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_front_axle_shaft_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical failure of the front axle drive shaft universal joints. A joint has broken and the front axle is no longer driven.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_axle_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light wear of the axle bearings. A slight rumble can be heard when driving.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_axle_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the axle bearings. The rumble rises with speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_axle_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the axle bearings. A bearing is flaking and starting to damage the bevel gear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_axle_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical wear of the axle bearings. A bearing has collapsed, the bevel gear is damaged and the axle no longer transmits drive.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_diff_lock_control_failure_branch1_stage1_description
text.text: Differential lock control failure. The lock no longer engages. The differential remains unlocked.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_diff_lock_control_failure_branch2_stage1_description
text.text: Differential lock control failure. The lock remains engaged. The machine resists steering when turning.
